caption:
Two hundred posts in, a few themes have come up again and again: cash-flow timing often matters more than the total amount involved, preparation consistently beats rushing, and finding the right fit for your specific situation matters more than chasing the lowest headline number.

Thank you for following along through products, education, industries and real scenarios — if any of it has raised a question about your own business, that conversation costs nothing to start.
